assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
CO-197 indicates precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient presents with intermittent lightheadedness.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91.
The clinical presentation is consistent with diagnosis codes I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
Reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and payment of the balance is requested.
